meta.label: REAL USGS HIVIS staff-gauge camera frames; physical numeral calibration, 0 fitted parameters, every frame held out
meta.protocol: Physical calibration (what an installer does): click the printed numerals on ONE reference frame and enter their values. stage_m = numeral_ft x 0.3048 with NO fitted parameters and NO gauge readings used, so every frame of the site is a held-out test frame. Estimator code and thresholds are frozen from the synthetic train split. In-range frames: truth within the marked span +/- 5 cm. Out-of-range frames (water below the gauge foot or gauge submerged) score as correct if the reading is clamped within 10 cm of the nearest gauge end.
meta.note: Single hourly snapshots: the temporal estimator E2 needs a burst and abstains here.
